remarks: Discover the charm of the Walterdale, a beautifully designed duplex home offering the perfect blend of comfort and functionality. Located exclusively in the prestigious Village at Griesbach, the Walterdale comes complete with landscaping, a finished deck, and fencing—all included for your convenience. Enjoy a move-in ready experience in one of Edmonton’s most sought-after communities, known for its scenic streetscapes, central location, and historic charm. No condo fees and appliances included. Enjoy a healthier indoor environment with a 3 Stage Medical-Grade Air Purification System and a Hi-Velocity Heating System that delivers efficient heating, cooling, filtration, and ventilation.
